title: Electrode
description: Electrode model composed of coating, current collector, tab, and optional properties. At least one of coating, current_collector, property is required.

electrode_spec_id.description: Optional canonical IRI of a standalone electrode-spec this inline holder realizes. Lets a cell-spec cite the designed electrode while keeping its embedded fields; the same reference seam material-component.schema.json gives materials.

coating.description: Coating layer of the electrode: component materials by role (active material, binder, conductive additive, other additives) and coating-level properties.

current_collector.description: Current-collector foil the coating is applied to.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of electrode-level properties (e.g. diameter, mass, theoretical_capacity, rated_areal_discharge_capacity). See the property keys reference for the full list of recognised keys.

tab.title: CurrentCollectorTab

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

property.description: Named quantity map of tab dimensions; expected keys are width, thickness, length, weld_width, and tape_width. See the property keys reference for the full list of recognised keys.

tab.description: Electrode current-collector tab: material plus its dimensions (width, thickness, length, weld_width, tape_width) under property.
